learning_order:
**Default view: Feral leveling (recommended by Method and most guides). Bear Form (10), Cat Form (20) and Aquatic Form (16) come from class quests, not the trainer.**

**Levels 1-10**
- Buy everything: Mark of the Wild, Moonfire, Rejuvenation (4), Thorns, Wrath R2 (6), Entangling Roots, Healing Touch R2 (8).
- At 10: Demoralizing Roar, Nature's Grasp (now baseline, works in forms), Moonfire/Rejuvenation/Mark ranks. Do the Bear Form quest.

**Levels 10-20 (Bear)**
- Enrage, Regrowth (12), Bash, Healing Touch R3, Thorns R2 (14), Swipe (16), Maul R2, Faerie Fire (18).
- Healing Touch R4 (20) is the most mana-efficient self-heal (Classic Warcraft Tavern).
- Revive (12) only for group play. Hibernate is niche.

**Level 20 (Cat)**
- Omen of Clarity (baseline passive), Shred, Mark of the Wild R3. Do the Cat Form quest.
- Rebirth and Starfire are optional for Feral (Starfire is Balance core after 30).

**Levels 20-30**
- Rake (24), Rip ranks, Dash (26), Remove Curse (24), Thorns R3.
- Skip Soothe Animal, Challenging Roar and Cower solo. Abolish Poison is group utility.
- From here Feral can skip most Wrath/Moonfire/Starfire ranks and buy heal ranks only now and then.

**Levels 30-40**
- Travel Form (30), Shred/Rip/Rake/Bite ranks, Ravage (32), Faerie Fire R2, Mark R4.
- Track Humanoids and Pounce are optional. Frenzied Regeneration (36) is a strong bear self-heal.
- Talent spells (Claw, Insect Swarm, Primal Bite, Wild Growth): buy their ranks if talented.

**Level 40**
- Dire Bear Form, Innervate, Mark of the Wild R5. Prowl R2 and Feline Grace are low priority. Save for the mount.

**Levels 40-60**
- Cat ranks (Shred, Rip, Rake, Ferocious Bite, Ravage, Claw), Barkskin (44), Mark ranks.
- Lacerate (42) and Maul/Swipe ranks only if you tank or level as bear. Tranquility and Hurricane are for healers/Balance.

**Money tips**
- Skinning + Leatherworking or Herbalism are the usual druid money professions (all guides read).
- Biggest savings for Feral: caster damage ranks and high heal ranks after 20 (Classic Warcraft Tavern trains almost only cat ranks after 20).
disagreements: Claw: Blizzard's deep dive and the trainer list treat Claw as talent-gated (Feral talent, rank 2 at 28); Warcraft Tavern Forever lists Claw as a level 20 class-quest reward with Cat Form.
Lacerate: Blizzard says baseline at level 42 (trainer list agrees: rank 3 at 42); Warcraft Tavern Forever lists it as a Feral bear talent at 25; Metabot shows ranks 1/2 at 25/34.
Frenzied Regeneration: Blizzard says it heals 100% of max health over its duration with enough rage; Metabot data shows the per-tick healing value down 90% (probably a changed formula).
Spec choice: Method/Warcraft Tavern favor Feral; Restoration is viable in groups; Balance 'gets the job done' but Feral is smoother (search summaries).
Classic Warcraft Tavern trains only cat ranks + Mark after 20; Forever guides give no explicit skip list.
forever_differences: Omen of Clarity, Nature's Grasp, Feral Faerie Fire, Improved Mark/Thorns/Enrage and Feral Aggression are baseline (Blizzard deep dive).
Faerie Fire (Feral) is removed as a separate spell; normal Faerie Fire is usable in Bear/Cat/Dire Bear Form at no cost with a 6s cooldown (Blizzard deep dive, Metabot).

New: Revive (out-of-combat res, 12), Lacerate (baseline at 42); Primal Bite (16-point Feral talent, replaces Mangle), Insect Swarm (16-point Balance talent), Wild Growth (31-point Resto talent) (Blizzard deep dive).
Tiger's Fury removed (replaced by Shifting Power talent); Furor energy mechanic prevents bear-weaving (Blizzard deep dive).

Feral attacks scale with weapon DPS; Claw and Shred damage significantly increased; Rake and Swipe scale more with AP; Shred learned at 20 instead of 22 (Blizzard deep dive, Metabot, Warcraft Tavern).
Wrath much cheaper with lower damage; Regrowth cheaper; Hurricane has no cooldown; Entangling Roots castable indoors; Thorns scales with spell power (Blizzard deep dive).
Barkskin usable in forms and costs no mana; consumables usable in forms (Blizzard deep dive, Metabot).
Mark of the Wild lasts 1 hour (Metabot).
Bear, Cat and Aquatic Form still come from class quests; Travel Form (30) and Dire Bear Form (40) from the trainer (Warcraft Tavern, Method).
Talents start at 10; Dual Specialization at 40 (Blizzard deep dive).
open_questions: Feline Grace (passive at 40): no guide read describes its Forever effect.
Ferocious Bite: Metabot says a new rank 1 at 24, but the trainer list starts at rank 2 (32); Warcraft Tavern lists Ferocious Bite at 24 (likely via the Cat quest).
